function.name: list_files
function.description: List the files in a directory. Folders end with '/'.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file, optionally returning an inclusive range of line numbers.

path.description: Path of the file to read

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a text file with the given content.

path.description: Path of the file to write

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a shell command and return its output. Optionally pass stdin text to test an interactive program without manual typing. The user approves it first when run_confirm is enabled.

stdin.description:
Optional text sent to the program's standard input, for example: '1
-3
2
'

function.name: find_text
function.description: Find literal text in project-local UTF-8 files. Results include file and line number; use path and glob to narrow the search.

path.description: Optional project-relative file or directory, default '.'

glob.description: Optional file pattern such as '*.py', default '*'

case_sensitive.description: Whether matching distinguishes upper and lower case; default false

max_results.description: Maximum matching lines to return, default 50

function.name: file_info
function.description: Return safe metadata for one project-local file or directory: type, size, extension, and modification time.

function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Apply one verified unified-diff patch to an existing project-local UTF-8 file. Prefer this for small edits instead of rewriting the full file.

path.description: Existing project-relative UTF-8 file to modify

patch.description: Unified diff hunks using @@ -old,+new @@ lines; optional --- and +++ headers are allowed

function.name: python_runtime_info
function.description: Detect the project .venv or venv, its Python interpreter, and whether pygame is installed. This does not create environments or install packages.

function.name: run_python
function.description: Run one project-local Python source file with the project .venv or venv when available; otherwise use the current Python. It has a bounded timeout and returns a structured report for verification. It never installs packages.

args.description: Optional command-line arguments, one array item per argument

stdin.description: Optional text sent to the program's standard input

timeout_seconds.description: Optional run limit in seconds; default 30

function.name: toolchain_info
function.description: Detect available C, C++, and Rust compiler commands on this computer. This is read-only; call it before compiling a non-Python program.

function.name: web_runtime_info
function.description: Detect Node.js and locally available browser commands for project-local web development. This is read-only.

function.name: serve_project
function.description: Serve a project-local directory over a temporary localhost HTTP server for web testing. The server ends with the agent host process.

port.description: Optional localhost port; use 0 or omit for an available port

function.name: browser_test
function.description: Read-only headless-browser check for a localhost URL returned by serve_project. It can verify that rendered DOM text is present; it never submits forms or visits external sites.

expected_text.description: Optional rendered text expected in the DOM
